result.topic_en: A geometric drawing of Gaussian-integer lattice points inside tilted squares, illustrating residues modulo the Gaussian integer -1+2i, with a congruence and a quotient noted at the bottom.

methods.what: Congruence of Gaussian integers modulo the Gaussian prime -1+2i
Quotient of Gaussian integers written as a complex number with fractional parts (denominator 5 = norm of the modulus)
Geometric representation of Gaussian integers as lattice points, with a tilted square grid generated by the modulus used to locate residues
